deals.buyers: Korea Investment & Securities Co., Ltd., Investment Arm; KIP Growth, Ltd.; Mobility Co-Invest, Limited Partnership; OA Mobility Limited
deals.comment: An undisclosed buyer, OA Mobility Limited, Mobility Co-Invest, Limited Partnership, KIP Growth, Ltd. and Korea Investment & Securities Co., Ltd., Investment Arm signed a contract to acquire 21% stake in KM Company Co., Ltd. from Kakao Corp. (KOSE:A035720) for KRW 300 billion on June 30, 2017. Kakao Corp. will sell 4.41 million shares and reduce holding to 16.59 million shares. Board of Directors of Kakao Corp. made a resolution in favor of the transaction on June 30, 2017. The sale date for 3.68 million shares worth KRW 250 billion is September 29, 2017 and sale date of remaining 0.74 million worth KRW 50 billion is within 3 months according to the funding situation. As of September 29, 2017, the sale of 3.68 million shares have been completed. OA Mobility Limited acquire 0.84%, Mobility Co-Invest, Limited Partnership acquired 4.2%, KIP Growth, Ltd. acquired 1.09%, Korea Investment & Securities Co., Ltd., Investment Arm acquired 0.13%, and another buyer acquired 11.24% stake.

An unknown buyer acquired additional 3.07% stake in Kakao Mobility from Kakao Corp. (KOSE:A035720) for KRW 50 billion on February 13, 2018. Kakao Corp. sold 0.74 million shares for KRW 68,027 each. Upon completion, the buyer owns 27.69% stake and Kakao Corp owns 69.3% stake in Kakao Mobility.

Kakao Mobility agreed to acquire LUXI Co., Ltd. for KRW 25.2 billion on February 9, 2018. Under the terms of transaction, Kakao Mobility will acquire 0.23 million shares for KRW 25.2 billion. The transaction has been resolved by Board of Kakao Mobility. The transaction expected to be completed by March 5, 2018.
Kakao Mobility Co., Ltd. acquired My Valet for KRW 7 billion effective December 30, 2020.
Kakao Mobility Co., Ltd. acquired DelCar app for around 8 billion won on March 18, 2021.
Kakao Mobility Co., Ltd. acquired Plus TV for KRW 6 billion on October 20, 2021. As of the end of last year, Plus TV generated revenues of around KRW 1.5 billion and operating loss of KRW 3 billion.
